title: Input-tape cell update rule
statement: For a finite-tape Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input symbols, an optional state $q$, read data $\rho$, an integer offset $d$, and input-tape contents $f:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$, define the updated cell symbol as follows. If $q$ is absent, use $f(d)$. If $q$ is present, retain $f(d)$ when the input symbol read is blank and the transition's input-tape movement leads to a blank cell; otherwise use $f(d+m)$, where $m$ is that transition's input-tape movement.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-tape Turing machine M with Boolean input symbols
Input-tape contents f from integers to optional Booleans
